searchText: ``` Jul 14 11:53:30.007 INFO Synced slot: 348567, block: 0x8a65…2961, epoch: 10892, finalized_epoch: 6920, finalized_root: 0xea49…0cd6, peers: 227, service: slot_notifier ``` my witti validator has 227 peers? is this even possible on witti? do we maintain connections with peers on different networks? ``` [2020-07-14 11:53:39] INFO blockchain: Synced new block block=0xec8e17d6... epoch=10892 finalizedEpoch=6920 finalizedRoot=0xea49cdcb... slot=348546 ``` my prysm validator has a different slot count than the lighthouse one. not sure which one is the correct one. what does teku show on witti <@!340345049063882753> ? I observe an offset of 22 slots. what could cause that? My witti node has a head block slot of 348581. I have 566 (Prysm) and 607 (Lighthouse) My Teku looks like it's in sync with your lighthouse as reported on https://eth2stats.io/witti-testnet Ok, that's explaining why I still see blocks 🙂 Yep, my 10 little validators are pumping away. Nearly 16,000 attestations produced since the last restart. About to celebrate 4000 epochs free from the tyranny of finalization. Regarding validator penalties, it does not appear to hurt being offline unless you completely forget about your node for weeks. I'm not sure this is a good thing. I'm all for being mild to short downtimes, but on the other hand, we should be very strict about validators failing their duties long-term....
